title: Advancing Mathematical Reasoning in Language Models: The Impact of Problem-Solving Data, Data Synthesis Methods, and Training Stages
authors_zh: Zui Chen、Tianqiao Liu、Mi Tian、Qing Tong、Weiqi Luo、Zitao Liu
paper_type_zh: 数学数据合成算子与训练阶段对照研究
best_for_zh: 关注数学推理数据合成、教师蒸馏、CPT/SFT 选择、污染与发布审计的研究者
one_line: Compares four math problem-synthesis operators and controlled CPT/SFT allocations, but releases MathGPT-8B rather than the source or synthetic corpora.
比较 response diversification、query expansion、retrospective enhancement 与 tutorship amplification 四种数学数据变换，并系统对照相同问题求解数据在 CPT 与 SFT 阶段的作用。
why: Treats transformation semantics and training stage as separate reasoning-data choices and identifies provenance, judge, rejection, budget, and license records still required for audit or reuse.
inclusion_reason: Compares four transformations of mathematical problem-solving records and their controlled use in CPT and SFT, while exposing audit gaps around proprietary inputs, LLM self-checks, unequal budgets, and unreleased synthetic data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The usual math-model pipeline assigns mathematical web text to continued pre-training (CPT) and reserves worked problems for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). This paper asks a narrower data-design question: whether questions paired with reasoning steps should already be consumed during CPT, whether their transformation method changes the outcome, and how the same problem-solving tokens behave when allocated to CPT or SFT. (Paper §1–§2.)

The study compares ordinary mathematical-corpus tokens, original problem-solving records, and four synthetic derivatives. Its central data objects are not just final answers: they include alternative worked solutions, transformed question-solution pairs with self-checks, artificial retry traces, and student-attempt/teacher-correction records. Each carries a different feedback signal and rationale structure.

For this atlas, the paper is both an instruction/demonstration/rationale data study and a construction-recipe comparison. The source and synthetic corpora are not released, however. Only the paper, prompts, an answer-comparison model, and the final MathGPT-8B checkpoint are public, so the work supports recipe audit and independent reimplementation rather than direct dataset reuse.

常见数学模型流程把数学网页文本用于 continued pre-training（CPT），把带过程的问题解答留给 supervised fine-tuning（SFT）。该论文研究一个更窄的数据设计问题：问题与推理步骤是否应在 CPT 阶段就被学习，不同变换方法是否改变结果，以及相同问题求解 token 分配到 CPT 或 SFT 时会怎样。（论文 §1–§2。）

研究比较普通数学语料 token、原始问题求解记录和四类合成衍生记录。核心数据对象不只是最终答案，还包括替代的带过程解答、带自检的变换问题—解答对、人工重试轨迹，以及学生尝试/教师纠错记录。它们具有不同反馈信号和 rationale 结构。

对本图谱而言，该论文同时属于 instruction/demonstration/rationale data 研究与构造 recipe 对比。但来源和合成语料均未发布；公开的只有论文、prompt、answer-comparison model 与最终 MathGPT-8B checkpoint。因此，它适合用于 recipe 审计和独立重实现，而不能直接复用 dataset。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper separates two choices often conflated in math-data work: the transformation applied to a problem-solution seed and the training stage that consumes the resulting tokens. The authors report collecting 25 million problem-solving records from NuminaMath, Lila, and proprietary data, then selecting 14 million as augmentation seeds. Source proportions and seed IDs are not published. (Appendix A.1.)

Response diversification produces two alternative solutions to the same question. Query expansion converts a source question to a statement, generates two new questions and solutions, and self-checks them. Retrospective enhancement inserts later steps into earlier reasoning and marks retry behavior with [back], producing an artificial backtracking trace. Tutorship amplification samples a weak student's solution and asks a stronger teacher to output correct or, when wrong, identify the erroneous step, repair it, and continue the solution. (Paper §4; Appendix G.)

These objects have different feedback contracts. Response and query synthesis use self-issued accept/refuse or correctness tags; tutorship uses another model's judgment and localized correction; no independent retrospective verifier is disclosed. The comparison then allocates problem-solving records to CPT or SFT. The released MathGPT-8B weights are the final model artifact, not a release of the 25 million source records, 14 million seeds, four synthetic families, or rejected candidates.

论文把数学数据研究中经常混在一起的两个选择分开：对问题—解答种子施加什么变换，以及生成 token 由哪个训练阶段消费。作者报告从 NuminaMath、Lila 与专有数据收集 2500 万条问题求解记录，并选取其中 1400 万条作为增强种子；来源比例和 seed ID 未发布。（Appendix A.1。）

Response diversification 为同一问题生成两个替代解。Query expansion 把原问题转成陈述，生成两个新问题及其解答并进行自检。Retrospective enhancement 把后续步骤插回更早推理，并用 [back] 标记重试，形成一条人工回溯轨迹。Tutorship amplification 先采样弱学生解答，再让更强教师输出 correct；若错误，则定位错误步骤、修正并继续完成解答。（论文 §4；Appendix G。）

这些对象的反馈契约不同。Response 与 query 合成使用模型自己发出的 accept/refuse 或正确性标签；tutorship 使用另一个模型的判断和局部纠错；retrospective 方法没有披露独立 verifier。论文随后比较问题求解记录分配到 CPT 或 SFT 的效果。公开的 MathGPT-8B 权重是最终模型 artifact，不是 2500 万来源记录、1400 万种子、四类合成记录或拒绝候选的发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
The training pool has three branches. General data draws on RedPajama ArXiv, C4, and Wikipedia together with AlgebraicStack and StarCoder code. OpenWebMath supplies the mathematical corpus. Problem-solving data combines NuminaMath, Lila, and proprietary records. Seeds are filtered for completeness and reasoning-step count, but exact thresholds, source proportions, and item manifests are absent. The main experiment repeatedly says 14.7B mathematical-corpus tokens; Appendix A.1 says 13.7B, an unresolved internal discrepancy. (Paper §2–§3; Appendix A.1 and C.)

The four operators are materially different. Response diversification asks for two correct, distinct extra solutions and requires an initial response tag whose value is accept or refuse. Query expansion creates two new question-solution pairs and self-checks each with Accept/Refuse plus a reason. Retrospective enhancement constructs a [back] retry trace by inserting later steps into earlier reasoning, but its full prompt, acceptance parser, and filtering are not disclosed. Tutorship samples a weak-model attempt; a strong teacher starts with a check tag whose value is correct or wrong; for a wrong attempt it identifies erroneous steps, corrects them, and continues. Generator, student, and teacher checkpoints, decoding, retries, parser behavior, and per-method yields are unknown. (Paper §4; Appendix G.)

Reported outputs are 14,018,544 records/6.82B tokens for response diversification, 24,459,192/4.78B for query expansion, 14,707,792/5.04B for retrospective enhancement, and 11,942,328/13.90B for tutorship amplification. Each arm adds its output to the Base2 CPT mixture; the unequal token budgets are part of the experimental treatment and prevent a quality-only comparison.

Controlled CPT uses Llama2 for at most 25,000 steps, global batch 1024, context length 4096, a 95/5 train-validation split, and learning rate warmed to 1e-4 then cosine-decayed to 1e-5. It selects the lowest validation-loss checkpoint. The stage comparison allocates 7.2B problem-solving tokens to CPT or SFT and adds 0.072B-token 1% SFT controls for instruction following. SFT uses batch 256, three epochs, cosine decay from 1e-5 to 1e-6, and reports the best of ten checkpoints.

The final MathGPT-8B starts from Llama3-8B, prioritizes problems with more than five reasoning steps, uses response diversification, query expansion, and especially tutorship amplification, and trains for 25,000 CPT steps at context length 8192. The paper specifies 39.6B general, 46.7B mathematical-corpus, and 51.1B problem-solving/synthetic tokens and describes the total as about 140B, including 100B math-related tokens. The model card repeats the 140B/100B statement.

训练池分为三支。通用数据来自 RedPajama ArXiv、C4、Wikipedia，以及 AlgebraicStack 与 StarCoder 代码；数学语料使用 OpenWebMath；问题求解数据混合 NuminaMath、Lila 与专有记录。种子按完整性和推理步骤数筛选，但精确阈值、来源比例与 item manifest 均缺失。主实验多次写明数学语料为 14.7B token，Appendix A.1 却写成 13.7B，这一内部差异未解决。（论文 §2–§3；Appendix A.1、C。）

四种算子的语义并不相同。Response diversification 要求生成两个正确且不同的附加解，并在开头给出值为 accept 或 refuse 的 response 标签。Query expansion 创建两个新问题—解答对，并以 Accept/Refuse 和理由自检。Retrospective enhancement 把后续步骤插回更早推理以构造 [back] 重试轨迹，但完整 prompt、接受 parser 与过滤方法未公开。Tutorship 先采样弱模型尝试；强教师以值为 correct 或 wrong 的 check 标签开头；若尝试错误，再定位错误步骤、修正并继续求解。生成器、学生与教师 checkpoint、decoding、retry、parser 行为和逐方法 yield 均未知。（论文 §4；Appendix G。）

论文报告的输出规模为：response diversification 14,018,544 条/6.82B token，query expansion 24,459,192/4.78B，retrospective enhancement 14,707,792/5.04B，tutorship amplification 11,942,328/13.90B。每个实验臂都把对应输出加入 Base2 CPT 混合；不相等的 token 预算属于实验处理的一部分，因此无法只比较数据质量。

受控 CPT 使用 Llama2，最多 25,000 step，global batch 1024，context length 4096，训练/验证划分 95/5；学习率先 warm up 至 1e-4，再 cosine 衰减至 1e-5，并选择 validation loss 最低的 checkpoint。阶段对比把 7.2B 问题求解 token 放入 CPT 或 SFT，并增加 0.072B-token 的 1% SFT 控制 instruction following。SFT 使用 batch 256、三轮训练、1e-5 至 1e-6 cosine 衰减，并报告十个 checkpoint 中的最佳值。

最终 MathGPT-8B 从 Llama3-8B 开始，优先选择超过五个推理步骤的问题，使用 response diversification、query expansion，尤其是 tutorship amplification，并以 context length 8192 训练 25,000 个 CPT step。论文列出 39.6B 通用、46.7B 数学语料和 51.1B 问题求解/合成 token，并把总量概述为约 140B，其中 100B 与数学相关；model card 也重复 140B/100B 的说法。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Table 1 reports average accuracy over GSM8K, MATH, GAOKAO, and ZHONGKAO of 39.50 for Base2, 41.30 for response diversification, 42.67 for query expansion, 39.12 for retrospective enhancement, and 50.60 for tutorship amplification. This supports that three operators improved the tested mixtures and tutorship produced the largest observed gain, while retrospective enhancement did not beat the control. It does not establish intrinsic record quality: tutorship adds 13.90B synthetic tokens versus 4.78B–6.82B for the other arms, and no independent teacher-error audit is reported. (Paper Table 1.)

For stage allocation, Table 8 reports Base1 at 19.11 average, Base1-SFT at 35.62, Base2 at 39.50, and their 1% SFT controls at 23.73 and 43.54. The authors estimate SFT's capability gain at about 60% of CPT's after subtracting the instruction-following effect. Difficulty experiments report Easy-SFT 27.03 versus Easy-CPT 30.79, and Hard-SFT 29.66 versus Hard-CPT 41.51. These comparisons support the paper's setup-specific stage finding, but CPT and SFT use different optimizers, exposures, and checkpoint selection, so they are not a stage-only causal proof. (Paper §5.1–§5.3, Table 3, Table 8.)

The final model result is broader but less diagnostic: MathGPT-8B scores 70.62 average over the four math sets versus 32.91 for Llama3-8B, and MMLU is reported as 0.6222 versus 0.6211. The final recipe changes base model, context length, data sources, operator mixture, difficulty filtering, and scale together. Its benchmark performance therefore cannot isolate any one synthesis operator or verify individual records. (Paper Table 4.)

Evaluation itself is judge-mediated. The paper uses Tianqiao/DeepSeek-7B-Math-Compare-Answer to normalize irregular outputs; its public prompt explicitly says to ignore errors in the student's reasoning and focus on the final answer. The paper then takes the better zero-shot or few-shot score per dataset. Reported accuracy is thus answer-level model judgment, not step-level rationale verification.

Artifact evidence is split. The MathGPT-8B Hugging Face repository was rechecked on 2026-07-22 and contains configuration, tokenizer, and two BF16 safetensor shards under Apache-2.0. No source/seed corpus, method-specific synthetic corpus, rejected-output log, synthesis code, or item-level lineage is released. artifact_verified: true refers to the model checkpoint, not to the training records.

Table 1 在 GSM8K、MATH、GAOKAO 与 ZHONGKAO 上报告的平均准确率为：Base2 39.50，response diversification 41.30，query expansion 42.67，retrospective enhancement 39.12，tutorship amplification 50.60。这支持“三种算子改善了所测混合、tutorship 观察增益最大、retrospective 未超过对照”的结论，却不能证明记录内在质量：tutorship 增加 13.90B 合成 token，其他实验臂只有 4.78B–6.82B，教师错误也没有独立审计。（论文 Table 1。）

阶段分配方面，Table 8 报告 Base1 平均 19.11，Base1-SFT 35.62，Base2 39.50，两组 1% SFT 控制分别为 23.73 与 43.54。作者在扣除 instruction-following 效应后估计，SFT 的能力增益约为 CPT 的 60%。难度实验中，Easy-SFT 为 27.03、Easy-CPT 为 30.79；Hard-SFT 为 29.66、Hard-CPT 为 41.51。这些比较支持论文设置下的阶段结论，但 CPT 与 SFT 的优化器、暴露量与 checkpoint 选择不同，不能构成只由训练阶段引起的因果证明。（论文 §5.1–§5.3、Table 3、Table 8。）

最终模型结果覆盖更广，却更难诊断。MathGPT-8B 在四个数学集合上的平均分为 70.62，Llama3-8B 为 32.91；MMLU 报告为 0.6222 对 0.6211。最终 recipe 同时改变 base model、context length、数据来源、算子混合、难度过滤与规模。因此，benchmark 表现不能隔离某一个合成算子，也不能验证单条记录。（论文 Table 4。）

评测本身依赖模型判断。论文用 Tianqiao/DeepSeek-7B-Math-Compare-Answer 规范化不规则输出；其公开 prompt 明确要求忽略学生推理中的错误，只关注最终答案。论文随后还对每个 dataset 取 zero-shot 与 few-shot 中较高的分数。因此，报告准确率属于 answer-level model judgment，而不是 step-level rationale verification。

Artifact 证据需要拆分。2026-07-22 再次检查 MathGPT-8B Hugging Face 仓库时，其中包含 configuration、tokenizer 与两个 BF16 safetensor shard，并标注 Apache-2.0。但来源/种子语料、逐方法合成语料、拒绝输出日志、合成代码与 item-level lineage 均未发布。artifact_verified: true 指模型 checkpoint，不指训练记录。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier math-model recipes commonly used web mathematical text during pre-training and worked solutions during post-training, while augmentation studies often isolated one reformulation or solution-generation method. This paper's useful change is a joint experimental decomposition by transformation semantics and training stage. (Paper §1 and related work.)

The most distinctive serialized object is tutorship amplification: it keeps a weak model's sampled attempt and pairs it with a stronger model's correctness judgment, error location, correction, and continuation. This differs from retrospective enhancement's artificial [back] trace and from response/query variants that primarily change solution paths or questions. The paper also compares training distribution and step-count difficulty around the same problem-solving pool.

The novelty is a comparative recipe and ablation framework, not an open corpus, formal verifier, or general proof that CPT dominates SFT. Teacher corrections, self-checks, alternative solutions, and error traces predate the paper. Its reusable contribution is the explicit distinction among these data objects and stages, bounded by unequal synthesis budgets and unreleased generator identities, records, and code.

以往数学模型 recipe 通常在预训练中使用数学网页文本，在后训练中使用带过程解答；数据增强研究也常单独考察一种改写或解答生成方法。该论文有用的变化，是同时按变换语义和训练阶段拆解实验。（论文 §1 与相关工作。）

最具区分度的序列化对象是 tutorship amplification：它保留弱模型采样的尝试，并配上更强模型的正确性判断、错误定位、修正与续写。这不同于 retrospective enhancement 的人工 [back] 轨迹，也不同于主要改变解法或问题的 response/query 变体。论文还围绕同一问题求解池比较训练分布与基于步骤数的难度。

其新意是比较性 recipe 与消融框架，而不是开放语料、形式化 verifier，或 CPT 普遍优于 SFT 的证明。教师纠错、自检、替代解与错误轨迹都早于该论文存在。可复用贡献在于明确区分这些数据对象和训练阶段，但必须受到不等合成预算、未披露生成器身份、未发布记录与代码的边界约束。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The paper mixes NuminaMath and Lila with proprietary problem data. Without source proportions, item IDs, terms, or the proprietary collection policy, provenance, redistribution rights, and contamination cannot be audited end to end. The CC BY 4.0 paper and Apache-2.0 model repository do not license the unreleased mixed corpus or its derivatives.

Generator, weak-student, and strong-teacher checkpoints are unknown, as are decoding, retries, parsers, random seeds, per-seed candidate counts, and acceptance yields. LLM-produced accept/refuse and correct/wrong tags are judgments, not proofs. They may accept invalid questions, correct answers with faulty reasoning, or teacher corrections that introduce new errors. Retrospective enhancement creates artificial backtracking rather than authentic sampled mistakes.

The synthesis arms differ substantially in token exposure, especially the 13.90B-token tutorship arm. CPT and SFT also differ in learning rate, batch size, number of passes, and checkpoint selection; SFT reports the best of ten checkpoints, while CPT uses validation loss. Step count is a coarse difficulty proxy, and evaluation selects the better zero-shot or few-shot result per dataset. The public comparison model checks final answers while ignoring rationale errors, leaving step-level quality unmeasured.

MinHash byte-overlap removal addresses narrow exact-text duplication and leakage, not semantic contamination. The main text and Appendix A.1 also disagree on 14.7B versus 13.7B mathematical-corpus tokens in the controlled study. Accepted records, rejected candidates, refusal reasons, false-accept rates, seed-to-output lineage, and synthesis code are unavailable. The released checkpoint enables model experiments but cannot substitute for data, licenses, or audit logs.

论文把 NuminaMath、Lila 与专有问题数据混合。由于缺少来源比例、item ID、使用条款和专有数据收集政策，无法端到端审计 provenance、再分发权利与污染。CC BY 4.0 论文和 Apache-2.0 模型仓库也不会为未发布的混合语料及其衍生记录授予许可。

生成器、弱学生与强教师 checkpoint 未知；decoding、retry、parser、random seed、逐 seed 候选数和接受 yield 也未知。LLM 产生的 accept/refuse 与 correct/wrong 标签是判断，不是证明。它们可能接受无效问题、最终答案正确但推理错误的解答，或由教师纠错时引入新错误。Retrospective enhancement 构造人工回溯，并非真实采样错误。

各合成实验臂的 token 暴露量差异很大，尤其 tutorship 达到 13.90B token。CPT 与 SFT 的 learning rate、batch size、数据遍历次数和 checkpoint 选择也不同；SFT 报告十个 checkpoint 中最佳值，CPT 则依据 validation loss。步骤数只是粗糙难度代理，评测还对每个 dataset 选择 zero-shot/few-shot 中较高者。公开 compare model 只检查最终答案并忽略 rationale 错误，因此 step-level quality 没有被测量。

MinHash 字节重叠删除只处理狭义 exact-text 重复和泄漏，不能排除语义污染。主文与 Appendix A.1 对受控研究中数学语料规模还分别给出 14.7B 与 13.7B，存在内部不一致。接受记录、拒绝候选、拒绝原因、假接受率、seed-to-output lineage 与合成代码均不可用。公开 checkpoint 可用于模型实验，但不能替代数据、许可证与审计日志。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Instruction, Demonstration, and Rationale Data track, the paper supplies a concrete taxonomy of four teaching targets: alternative worked solutions, transformed question-solution pairs with self-checks, artificial backtracking traces, and sampled student attempts paired with teacher judgments and corrections. Follow-up studies can compare these schemas without treating all synthetic rationales as interchangeable.

For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, it is most useful as an ablation blueprint. A reproduction should pin source and seed IDs; disclose generator, student, teacher, and answer-judge revisions; publish prompts and parsers; equalize or factorially vary token budgets; retain every candidate, refusal, and judge decision; and report per-method yield, false accepts, and correction error. CPT/SFT comparisons should align exposure and checkpoint selection or explicitly model their effects.

The work can guide continued-pretraining mixture studies, minimal SFT controls for instruction following, difficulty sampling based on solution structure, and studies of correction traces. Authentic student-error data and symbolic, executable, or multi-judge checking would be important controls for retrospective and tutorship synthesis. Step validity should be audited separately from final-answer accuracy.

The present reuse boundary is model evaluation plus recipe reimplementation. Training-data reuse remains blocked by the unavailable corpora, proprietary-source rights, missing item lineage, and absent synthesis code. A model checkpoint is useful evidence that an artifact exists, but not a substitute for a reusable data release.

对 Instruction, Demonstration, and Rationale Data track，论文提供了四类具体教学目标：替代的带过程解答、带自检的变换问题—解答对、人工回溯轨迹，以及采样学生尝试与教师判断/纠正的配对记录。后续研究可以比较这些 schema，而不把所有 synthetic rationale 视为可互换数据。

对 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track，该论文最适合作为消融蓝图。复现者应固定来源与 seed ID，披露 generator、student、teacher 与 answer judge revision，发布 prompt 与 parser，使 token 预算相等或做因子化变化，保留全部候选、拒绝与 judge 决策，并报告逐方法 yield、假接受和纠错错误。CPT/SFT 对比应对齐暴露量与 checkpoint 选择，或明确建模其影响。

该工作可指导 continued-pretraining mixture、用于控制 instruction following 的少量 SFT、按解答结构进行难度采样，以及纠错轨迹研究。真实学生错误数据，以及符号、可执行或多 judge 检查，是 retrospective 与 tutorship 合成的重要对照。步骤有效性也应与最终答案准确率分开审计。

当前复用边界是模型评测与 recipe 重实现。由于语料不可用、专有来源权利不明、item lineage 缺失且合成代码未发布，训练数据复用仍然 blocked。模型 checkpoint 能证明某个 artifact 存在，却不能替代可复用数据发布。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep four quantities separate—25M collected records, 14M synthesis seeds, each method's output count/token budget, and the final model's approximately 140B-token CPT mixture—and note the controlled-study inconsistency between 14.7B mathematical-corpus tokens in the main setup/Appendix C and 13.7B in Appendix A.1.
  • Response diversification, query expansion, retrospective enhancement, and tutorship amplification create different schemas and feedback signals.
  • Tutorship has the highest reported synthesis score but also the largest synthetic-token exposure; this is not standalone evidence of record quality.
  • CPT/SFT comparisons use 1% SFT controls for instruction following, but optimization and checkpoint selection still differ.
  • accept/refuse, teacher correct/wrong, and the evaluation compare model are model judgments; the compare model explicitly ignores rationale errors and checks the final answer.
  • MathGPT-8B weights are released. Source, seed, synthetic, rejected, and decision records are not.

• 区分四种数量：2500 万收集记录、1400 万合成种子、各方法的输出条数/token 预算，以及最终模型约 140B-token 的 CPT 混合；同时注意受控研究的数学语料规模在主实验/Appendix C 中为 14.7B，在 Appendix A.1 中却为 13.7B。
  • Response diversification、query expansion、retrospective enhancement 与 tutorship amplification 产生不同 schema 和反馈信号。
  • Tutorship 的合成实验得分最高，但其 synthetic-token 暴露量也最大；这不能单独证明记录质量。
  • CPT/SFT 对比使用 1% SFT 控制 instruction following，但优化与 checkpoint 选择仍不同。
  • accept/refuse、教师 correct/wrong 和评测 compare model 都是模型判断；compare model 明确忽略 rationale 错误，只检查最终答案。
  • MathGPT-8B 权重已发布；来源、种子、合成、拒绝与决策记录均未发布。

value_zh.html: 比较四种算子：回复多样化、查询扩展、回顾增强与辅导放大。

value.html: Apply one operator to filtered seeds, add retained outputs to an experiment-specific mixture, and run separate CPT comparisons. Candidate retry counts, random seeds, decoding settings, and selection yields are unknown.

value.html: Seeds are filtered for completeness and number of reasoning steps. Response diversification requests two distinct solutions and an accept/refuse tag; query expansion creates two new question-solution pairs and self-checks each; tutorship asks a teacher to judge and correct a student's solution. The final recipe emphasizes seeds with more than five reasoning steps. Exact parser, retry, and retrospective acceptance behavior are unknown.

value_zh.html: 种子按完整性与推理步数过滤。回复多样化请求两个不同解答及 accept/refuse 标签；查询扩展创建两对新问题-解答并各自自检；辅导要求教师模型判定并纠正学生解答。最终配方强调推理步数多于五的种子。精确解析器、重试与回顾接受行为未知。

value.html: Reported synthesis outputs are 14,018,544 records/6.82B tokens for response diversification, 24,459,192/4.78B for query expansion, 14,707,792/5.04B for retrospective enhancement, and 11,942,328/13.90B for tutorship amplification. The final model is reported as using about 140B CPT tokens, 100B math-related.

value_zh.html: 所报告合成输出为：回复多样化 14,018,544 条记录/6.82B tokens，查询扩展 24,459,192/4.78B，回顾增强 14,707,792/5.04B，辅导放大 11,942,328/13.90B。最终模型据报使用约 140B CPT tokens，其中 100B 与数学相关。

value.html: Controlled CPT runs for at most 25,000 steps with global batch 1024, context length 4096, a 95/5 train-validation split, and learning rate warmed to 1e-4 then cosine-decayed to 1e-5. SFT uses batch 256, cosine decay from 1e-5 to 1e-6, three epochs, and reports the best of ten checkpoints. Final MathGPT-8B uses context length 8192 and otherwise reports the same CPT step, batch, and learning-rate schedule.

value_zh.html: 受控 CPT 至多运行 25,000 步，全局 batch 1024、上下文长度 4096、95/5 训练-验证划分，学习率预热至 1e-4 再余弦衰减至 1e-5。SFT 使用 batch 256、从 1e-5 余弦衰减至 1e-6、三个 epoch，并报告十个检查点中的最佳。最终 MathGPT-8B 使用上下文长度 8192，其余报告与 CPT 相同的步数、batch 与学习率日程。

value.html: General data includes RedPajama ArXiv, C4, and Wikipedia plus AlgebraicStack and StarCoder code; mathematical corpus uses OpenWebMath; problem-solving data mixes NuminaMath, Lila, and proprietary records. Main experiments repeatedly specify 14.7B mathematical-corpus tokens, while Appendix A.1 states 13.7B; this internal discrepancy is unresolved. Synthetic arms add unequal record and token counts.

value_zh.html: 通用数据包括 RedPajama ArXiv、C4 与 Wikipedia，外加 AlgebraicStack 与 StarCoder 代码；数学语料使用 OpenWebMath；解题数据混合 NuminaMath、Lila 与专有记录。主实验反复指定 14.7B 数学语料 tokens，而附录 A.1 写 13.7B；该内部不一致未解决。合成臂加入不等的记录与 token 计数。

value.html: Controlled CPT reports a 95/5 train-validation split. Item-level splits, immutable manifests, source-to-seed partitions, and seed-to-output partitions are not released.

value_zh.html: 受控 CPT 报告 95/5 训练-验证划分。条目级划分、不可变清单、来源到种子分区与种子到输出分区未发布。

value.html: MinHash removes documents containing duplicate spans above 2048 bytes and training documents containing more than 100 bytes overlapping evaluation train or test subsets. The paper reports removing 2,594 OpenWebMath documents in one audit. This exact-text rule does not establish semantic decontamination.

value_zh.html: MinHash 移除含超过 2048 bytes 重复跨度的文档，以及与评测 train 或 test 子集重叠超过 100 bytes 的训练文档。论文报告一次审计中移除 2,594 篇 OpenWebMath 文档。该精确文本规则并不确立语义去污染。

items: Proprietary source data prevents complete provenance, rights, and contamination audits.
Generator, strong-teacher, and weak-student checkpoints, decoding, retries, and random seeds are unknown.
Self-issued accept/refuse and correctness judgments can retain invalid questions, answers, or reasoning.
Retrospective enhancement constructs backtracking errors rather than sampling authentic student mistakes.
The four synthesis arms add unequal token volumes, so benchmark differences do not isolate transformation quality.
CPT and SFT use different optimization and checkpoint-selection procedures, limiting a stage-only causal interpretation.
The evaluation comparison model explicitly focuses on final answers and ignores reasoning errors, so reported accuracy does not validate rationale quality.
Rejected outputs, per-method yields, false-accept rates, and item-level lineage are unavailable.
A released model checkpoint is not a release of source, synthetic, or rejected training records.
专有源数据阻碍完整的溯源、权利与污染审计。
生成器、强教师模型与弱学生检查点、解码、重试与随机种子未知。
自行发出的 accept/refuse 与正确性判定可能保留无效问题、答案或推理。
回顾增强构造回溯错误，而非采样真实学生错误。
四种合成臂加入不等的 token 量，因此基准差异并不能分离变换质量。
CPT 与 SFT 使用不同的优化与检查点选择程序，限制了仅阶段的因果解释。
评测比较模型明确聚焦最终答案并忽略推理错误，因此所报告准确率并不核验理由质量。
被拒绝输出、按方法产量、错误接受率与条目级谱系不可得。
已发布的模型检查点并非源、合成或被拒绝训练记录的发布。
